newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks settle lower, dragged down by futures.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks settle lower, dragged down by futures.

text.p: Tokyo stocks settled lower on Monday, with their drop eating away at the huge gains they posted late last week. Brokers said outright cash trades were fairly thin and that futures-linked activity was responsible for the fluctuations in the Nikkei average.
The 225-issue Nikkei average lost 135.96 points or 0.64 percent to land at 21,065.08. Its December futures were 100 points lower at 21,100.
"There were hopes that the sharp gains made last week would be maintained, but arbitrage-linked selling dragged down the indices," said Akihiro Naemura, Okasan Securities strategist.
